name: YouTube Transcript APIs for AI Agents
description: Pay-per-call YouTube transcript, captions and video-to-text APIs for autonomous AI agents, LLM/RAG pipelines, research and automation. No signup. USDC on Base via x402.

capabilities.name: youtube-transcript
capabilities.description: Extract YouTube transcript, captions and subtitles with timestamps, language selection and JSON/text/SRT output

capabilities.name: youtube-captions
capabilities.description: Extract YouTube captions and subtitles with timestamps and language selection

capabilities.name: youtube-video-to-text
capabilities.description: Convert YouTube video to clean transcript text
